fn publish_chained_trace(agent: Address, market_id: u64, action: String, trace_hash: BytesN<32>, ipfs_cid: String, expected_seq: u64, prev_trace_hash: BytesN<32>) -> Result<u64, Error>

### `Error`

| Code | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `NotInitialized` | — |

| 7 | `EmptyCid` | — |
| 8 | `ChainHeadMismatch` | `expected_seq` / `prev_trace_hash` don't extend the agent's chain head (#52). |
| 9 | `ChainedAgentMustChain` | Agent already has a chain, so unchained `publish_trace` is refused (#52). |
| 10 | `TraceAlreadyConsumed` | Trace already backed an action (#50). |
| 11 | `NoPendingAdmin` | `accept_admin`/`cancel_admin_transfer` called with nothing proposed. |
| 12 | `PendingAdminExpired` | A proposed admin handover was not accepted within its `expires_at`. |
